facts: The NBS experiment uses hydroperoxide mixture 3/4 (50 mg, 0.27 mmol), NBS (51 mg, 0.284 mmol) and Et3N (4.2 uL, 0.03 mmol) in 6 mL anhydrous DCM under argon for 4 h. Temperature is unreported. The selected molecular object is (R,E)-4. Six-membered tetrahydropyran products have chromatographic/NMR profiles similar to the enzyme reaction. The 18% isolated yield belongs to the mixed-substrate procedure.
scope: Local nonenzymatic bromocyclization selectivity of (R)-4 with NBS/Et3N in DCM. Compound 7 is an optional comparison object; its measured product distribution comes from an enzyme experiment. The enzyme cycle and upstream photochemistry are excluded.
